decision_question: For ordinary AM Motors used-car inventory, which execution bundle produces better qualified-inquiry efficiency: a compact visual inventory Reel or a spoken walkaround Reel?
hypothesis: The two currently observed UAE inventory-format bundles may produce materially different qualified-demand outcomes for AM Motors; current evidence is insufficient to predict a winner, so a controlled internal test is required.

evidence_basis.finding: Fresh direct inspection of UAE used-car sellers confirms both compact silent/visual inventory Reels and longer spoken walkarounds are in current use; no fresh lead/sales outcome proves a winner.
Prior 200-post UAE competitor work showed hypercar/spectacle outliers are not a valid operating model for ordinary inventory and commercially relevant content must be judged beyond reach.
Prior frame analysis found generic beauty-only openings and conventional presenter setups were not reliable reach winners; content job and opening event matter.

audience.buying_stage: People evaluating the exact used vehicle shown in the Reel; finer buyer-segment claims are unresolved and must not be invented.
audience.need_or_job: Decide whether the shown vehicle is worth a direct inquiry and possible in-person inspection/test drive.
audience.budget_or_payment_context: Not used as a creative claim in this experiment unless separately verified and approved.
audience.trust_or_risk_concern: Only concerns explicitly supported by verified unit facts/proof may be used.
audience.geography_or_language: UAE; execution language to be fixed before production and kept comparable across variants.
audience.inventory_fit: Reference vehicle AM-018 Hyundai Santa Fe 2010, Korean Specs; availability must be rechecked before production/publication.

mechanism_to_test: Format bundle. VISUAL_COMPACT uses a short visual inventory presentation without spoken explanation. SPOKEN_WALKAROUND uses a presenter/voice-led walkaround with visual demonstration. Speech presence, information density and natural bundle-appropriate duration are intentionally part of the tested format package; this experiment does not isolate the causal effect of speech alone.
commercial_path: PRE-LAUNCH BLOCKER: confirm one current CTA destination and tracking path. Both variants must use the same destination.
primary_kpi: Qualified inquiries attributable to each variant, normalized by delivered impressions/reach where available.
secondary_kpis: Appointment/test-drive proposal rate among qualified inquiries
Appointment/test-drive set rate among qualified inquiries
Retention/completion as diagnostic content signals only
guardrail_metrics: Same vehicle and same verified commercial-fact set across variants
Do not call a raw-view winner the business winner when qualified-demand metrics disagree
baseline: No valid AM Motors format-specific qualified-lead baseline is attached. Analytics must register the available account baseline or a direct arm-vs-arm operational comparison before launch.
success_threshold: PRE-LAUNCH BLOCKER: Analytics must define an executable success threshold tied to qualified inquiries/appointments before approval.
failure_threshold: PRE-LAUNCH BLOCKER: Analytics must define an executable failure/inconclusive rule before approval.
minimum_sample: PRE-LAUNCH BLOCKER: Analytics must set the minimum delivered sample and/or qualified-inquiry requirement from current traffic and measurement capacity.
test_window: PRE-LAUNCH BLOCKER: Analytics must set the observation window and decision date.
variable_being_tested: Inventory presentation format bundle: VISUAL_COMPACT vs SPOKEN_WALKAROUND.
controlled_variables: Same exact vehicle for the paired comparison
Same offer scope; price/value positioning excluded unless separately cleared
Same vehicle preparation and capture window where practical
Same distribution settings if paid; if organic, record distribution non-comparability and limit causal claims
Same tracking identifiers and lead qualification logic
execution_constraints: Human must approve experiment/publication state before release.
Analytics instrumentation, thresholds, sample/window and attribution must be ready before publication.
Content Analyst must treat the format bundle as the tested variable and keep factual proof/CTA invariants stable.
Content Creator may adapt shot order, pacing and speech execution only as required by each declared bundle; those differences are part of the tested format.
Commercial fact values must come from current authoritative business sources, not this experiment file.
attribution_method: Use immutable experiment_id + variant_id + creative/content IDs and preserve inquiry source through Sales funnel events. Paid execution should use a proper split-test path when available. Organic execution has a lower causal claim ceiling and must record timing/distribution differences.

decision_rule.continue: Continue while the preregistered sample/window is incomplete and no truth/tracking guardrail is violated.
decision_rule.iterate: If one bundle shows useful qualified-demand signal but execution quality is defective or tracking is incomplete, repair only the responsible layer and rerun a bounded test.
decision_rule.scale: Adopt a format as the preferred operating baseline only if the preregistered qualified-demand threshold is met with commercially relevant appointment behavior and no truth guardrail failure.
decision_rule.kill: Park a format after a valid failure threshold or repeated evidence that it produces poorer qualified-demand efficiency with no downstream compensation.

learning_note: This is a format-bundle selection test, not a scientific decomposition of speech, duration or editing. If a bundle wins, later experiments may isolate the responsible component.
